newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa in late rebound as shorts cover.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa in late rebound as shorts cover.

text.p: Cocoa futures staged a late rally to end Tuesday broadly higher with benchmark September regaining a foothold above 1,040 stg a tonne.
Traders said the advance was spurred by short covering after recent losses. A slight fall in sterling against the dollar and the mark also lifted sentiment.
Cocoa's gains were also probably exaggerated by relatively thin volume.
September bounced from a low of 1,027 stg, seen as immediate support, to end the day 12 stg higher at 1,045.
The contract had slipped below 1,040 on Monday as sterling strengthened against major currencies.
Overall volume was 4,387 lots, led by September and December contracts.
Technically, traders said the market was probably near its immediate bottom after the recent sharp retracement from the July 1 peak of 1,170.
The next key support after 1,027 was at 1,000, the bottom of the current range. On the upside, resistance was pegged around 1,060.
